caption: The video depicts a white-haired, bearded man in glasses and a gray suit standing at the right against a plain gray studio background, holding an open spiral notebook and reading it. At the left, a dark-gray articulated robot arm with a silver camera-like module holds a white mug by its handle, keeping it extended toward the man. The robot's gripper maintains contact with the handle throughout, and the mug stays level as the man's attention remains on the notebook. The man's right hand, initially hidden behind the page, rises above the notebook with curled fingers. His hand then moves leftward toward the offered mug, approaching the mug body while he continues reading. As the scene progresses, his fingers touch and rest against the mug on the side facing him, without taking it from the arm. A green indicator ring at the robot's joint glows brightly during most of this motion. The man and robot remain in this ongoing exchange, the notebook still open in his left hand and the mug still held by the machine.
